description: This Java source file defines the RoleEditor class, a custom property editor in the OpenMRS project that serializes and deserializes Role objects for form data processing and URL parameter handling. It includes mechanisms to retrieve Role objects by name or UUID, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: RoleEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing Role objects, allowing access via role name or UUID for Spring framework data binding.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a string (role name or UUID) into a Role object and sets it as the current value.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Retrieves the role's name as string, or empty string if no role is set.
